title: Prove unacknowledged-message reminders on released harnesses
text: Source tests prove a reminder per backoff on every claude, codex and cursor surface inject event, reminder rendering and settlement, and seat receipts for handed-over steering mail. The batched release still owes live proof that a real Cursor and Claude session receives the reminder and that a re-acquired seat injects parked mail. This is a delivery obligation of the current change, not deferred implementation.
